title: Veracruz-style fish with tomatoes, olives and rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Chop the onion, garlic and chilli and sweat them in the oil for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, olives and oregano, simmer for 10 minutes to a sauce and season with salt.
Season the fish with lime juice and salt, lay it in the sauce and poach covered for 8–10 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with rice.
